messages:
deploy-bot: Heads-up — scheduling a short change window for model/runtime pinning: 2025-06-12 01:00–03:00 UTC. EU region only. Action: pin runtime -> model v2.3.1 and apply kernel micropatch. Need customer-facing status copy and an email snippet. Rolling staged deploy, fallback plan intact.
sara: copying a quick statuspage blurb below, please check and edit. want short and explicit for customers.
diego: confirm rollback plan: if latency regressions > 15% for 10m we roll back to v2.3.0 and open maintenance page. do we want to call out dedicated customers who will not be impacted?
matt: oncall will run smoke tests 15m pre, and a second sweep on canary. if errors spike we'll hold the rollout. have the runbook ready: /docs/runbooks/deploy-pin-checklist (internal).
sara: statuspage snippet draft:
```
We are applying a scheduled maintenance window to optimize inference runtime in the EU region on 2025-06-12 01:00–03:00 UTC. During this time some requests may see transient increased latency for a small fraction of traffic while we pin to a verified runtime/model build. Production throughput and entitlements are not expected to be impacted. We will update this page if the window is extended or if customers need to take action.
```
jen: add a short email subject/body for customers who have >$5k monthly spend (we'll send a targeted heads-up). sara can you add a line for dedicated/Private customers that they are not affected unless we've explicitly scheduled their hosts?
sara: yep — draft email snippet here:
Subject: Upcoming maintenance: EU inference runtime optimization (Jun 12)
Body: Hello — we will be performing a brief optimization and pin of our inference runtime in the EU region on Jun 12 01:00–03:00 UTC. Most customers will see no change; a small portion of requests may experience short latency variance while we finish the rollout. Dedicated/Private customers: no action required unless you received a separate notice. We will post updates to our status page and contact list if anything changes.
diego: technical note to include on internal ops channel: pinned to model v2.3.1; fallback path = v2.3.0 + region routing to US-west if EU capacity degraded. Command used for pin:
```bash
redwoodctl pin-model --region eu --model-id redwood/v2.3.1 --reason "kernel opt"
```
matt: ack. oncall will be watching the error budget and latency SLOs, have automations to pause the rollout on threshold.
statusbot: [incident] scheduled: EU runtime pinning - start 2025-06-12T01:00:00Z, expected end 2025-06-12T03:00:00Z.
sara: final QA pass: shortened statuspage blurb and email copy above. can someone from eng-platform + product approve? tagging @diego @jen :thumbsup:
diego: :thumbsup: approved from eng-platform.
jen: approved from product. send to support ops for scheduling and publish.
sara: will post statuspage and staged email list at T-24h and remind at T-1h. thread complete.
